description: This source file defines a PySide6 GUI dialog class 'ExclusionMatrix' that provides an interface for managing a matrix of mutually exclusive behaviors, including selection and checking/unchecking behaviors in a table with various control buttons.

classes.name: ExclusionMatrix
classes.description: A QDialog subclass that provides a user interface for managing an exclusion matrix of behaviors, allowing users to check, uncheck, select, and revert behavior exclusions via a table and various control buttons.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exclusion matrix dialog layout, widgets, and signal connections.

methods.name: pb_selected(self, to_check: bool)
methods.description: Checks or unchecks checkboxes in the selected ranges within the table, depending on the 'to_check' boolean parameter.

methods.name: pb_cb_selection(self, mode)
methods.description: Handles button actions to select, unselect, or revert checkboxes in the entire table based on the given mode.

methods.name: cb_clicked(self)
methods.description: Synchronizes checkbox states based on current selections, ensuring mutual exclusivity or consistent states across related behaviors.
